2607.07743.title: Architecture Generalization with MetaNCA
2607.07743.paper_summary: Self-organization is an emergent property of life, driven by the collective behavior of individual components acting on local information. Biological neurons, through local interactions transmitted through synapses, are able to learn efficiently and can adapt their connections over an organism's lifespan. Motivated by these desirable properties of adaptability and local interaction, neural cellular automata (NCA) models have been successful at learning morphogenesis solely through local update rules, demonstrating stability over many updates and robustness to perturbations. In this work, we introduce Meta Neural Cellular Automata (MetaNCA), a framework that learns local rules which self-organize the weights of artificial neural networks. A learned rule network iteratively updates the weights of a task network using only local interactions on the computation graph. We propose a novel Weight Transformer architecture for the local rule network, which uses linear attention to aggregate signals from neighboring weights and hidden states. Once trained, the rule network generates task networks of diverse architectures without backpropagation. We show that MetaNCA generates weights for feedforward MLPs, CNNs, and ResNets on MNIST and CIFAR-100, scaling to networks of 2 million parameters. We further show that MetaNCA generalizes to architectures not seen during meta-training, and that architectural diversity in the training phase strengthens this generalization.
2607.07743.paper_summary_zh: 自組織是生命的一種突現特性，由個別組件在局部信息上進行集體行為驅動。生物神經元通過突觸傳遞的局部互動，能夠有效學習並能夠在有機體的生命週期內適應其連接。受到這些適應性和局部互動的理想特性的啟發，神經細胞自動機（NCA）模型成功地僅通過局部更新規則學習形態生成，並在多次更新中顯示出穩定性和對擾動的魯棒性。在這項工作中，我們介紹了元神經細胞自動機（MetaNCA），這是一個學習局部規則的框架，該規則自組織人工神經網絡的權重。一個學習到的規則網絡通過僅在計算圖上的局部互動，迭代地更新任務網絡的權重。我們提出了一種新穎的權重轉換器架構，用於局部規則網絡，該架構使用線性注意力來聚合來自相鄰權重和隱藏狀態的信號。一旦訓練完成，規則網絡可以在不進行反向傳播的情況下生成多樣化架構的任務網絡。我們展示了MetaNCA為MNIST和CIFAR-100上的前饋多層感知器（MLP）、卷積神經網絡（CNN）和殘差網絡（ResNet）生成權重，並擴展到200萬參數的網絡。我們進一步展示了MetaNCA能夠泛化到在元訓練期間未見過的架構，並且訓練階段的架構多樣性增強了這種泛化。
